content.short: Taiko is a high-performance Type 1 ZK-Rollup that provides a fully Ethereum-equivalent Layer 2 network.
content.description: Taiko is a revolutionary decentralized ZK-Rollup network developed to provide a highly scalable and secure environment for decentralized applications without compromising Ethereum equivalence. By being a Type 1 ZK-EVM, Taiko allows developers to deploy existing Ethereum smart contracts and use familiar tools with zero modifications, ensuring a seamless transition. The network features specialized infrastructure for high-speed transactions and extremely low fees, while maintaining the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet. Taiko focuses on fostering a vibrant and permissionless ecosystem, serving as a critical engine for the mass adoption of Ethereum and the next generation of decentralized innovation.
content.meta: Taiko is a premier Type 1 ZK-Rollup, offering high scalability, low fees, and full Ethereum equivalence for decentralized applications and developers.
